name: Harry
source: He is a student who attends Middleton High School and is from a wealthy family. His family is friends of Wanda's family; he has known [url=/c133307]Wanda[/url] and her family for years enough that they act casually outside of school. He dislikes [url=/c133456]Steffy[/url], his father's fiancee.
